Below is a quick‑reference list of the **long weekends** that occurred in Canada during 2023.  
(“Long weekend” means a holiday that falls on a Friday or a Monday, giving you a 3‑day break that includes the weekend.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Observed (if different) | Long‑weekend days | Notes |
|---------|-------------|--------------------------|-------------------|-------|
| **New Year’s Day** | Jan 1 (​Sunday) | Jan 2 (Monday) | Jan 1–2 | 2‑day weekend (holiday on Sunday, observed Monday) |
| **Family Day** (Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, Ontario) | Feb 20 (Monday) | – | Feb 18–20 | 3‑day weekend |
| **Good Friday** | Apr 7 (Friday) | – | Apr 7–9 | 3‑day weekend |
| **Victoria Day** | May 22 (Monday) | – | May 20–22 | 3‑day weekend |
| **Canada Day** | Jul 1 (Saturday) | Jul 3 (Monday) | Jul 1–3 | 3‑day weekend (holiday on Saturday, observed Monday) |
| **Labour Day** | Sep 4 (Monday) | – | Sep 2–4 | 3‑day weekend |
| **Thanksgiving** | Oct 9 (Monday) | – | Oct 7–9 | 3‑day weekend |
| **Remembrance Day** | Nov 11 (Friday) | – | Nov 11–13 | 3‑day weekend |
| **Christmas Day** | Dec 25 (Monday) | – | Dec 23–25 | 3‑day weekend |
| **Boxing Day** | Dec 26 (Tuesday) | Dec 27 (Wednesday) | – | No long weekend (holiday on Tuesday, observed Wednesday) |

### Provincial variations
- **Family Day** is observed in Alberta, British Columbia, Saskatchewan, and Ontario (Feb 20, 2023).  
- Other provinces/territories that do **not** observe Family Day (e.g., Manitoba, Quebec, Newfoundland & Labrador, Nova Scotia, New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island, Yukon, Northwest Territories, Nunavut) have no additional long weekends in 2023 beyond the federal holidays listed above.

### How to use this data
- **Filter by province**: If your app needs province‑specific holidays, keep the Family Day entry only for the relevant provinces.  
- **Calendar integration**: Store each holiday as an event with its “observed” date (if applicable) so users see the correct day off.  
- **Reminder logic**: Trigger reminders a few days before the long weekend starts (e.g., 2 days before the holiday) to help users plan trips.

Feel free to let me know if you’d like the same information broken down by province or if you need additional holiday types (e.g., provincial holidays that create long weekends).
